reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://doi.org/10.1145/3805622.3810693. Abstract summary: Semi-supervised multimodal sentiment analysis is attractive because large-scale multimodal data are easy to collect, yet sentiment annotation is costly. However, pseudo supervision from a teacher model is often noisy, and distilling point-wise sentiment scores can cause error accumulation, especially for fine-grained sentiment. Out of scope: Multimodal sentiment training/distillation.
title: ReNoRD: Learning from Relations under Noisy Pseudo Labels via Relational Distillation for Multimodal Sentiment
